outlooks.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND OCCASIONAL HAIL WILL OCCUR FROM PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST SOUTHWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TODAY. MORE ISOLATED AND/OR MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM ARIZONA TO THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: CYCLONIC FLOW WILL ONCE AGAIN PREVAIL OVER THE NORTHEAST QUARTER OF THE NATION...ON SRN FRINGE OF NRLY STNRY UPR LOW CENTERED OVER ERN HUDSON BAY. SHORTWAVE DISTURBANCES SHEARING NEWD ON THE SE FLANK OF THE LOW WILL MAINTAIN SEASONABLY STRONG SW TO WSW FLOW ACROSS THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES...THE LWR GRT LKS...AND NORTHEAST. ELSEWHERE...A RIDGE WILL PERSIST OVER THE RCKYS AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER ERN NEB AMPLIFIES ESE INTO THE LWR OH VLY. FEATURES WILL REMAIN WEAK AT THE SFC...WITH A SERIES OF DIFFUSE COLD FRONTAL SURGES CONTINUING TO PROGRESS SLOWLY E/SE ACROSS THE ERN GRT LKS...THE APPALACHIANS...AND THE LWR OH AND TN VLYS. THE SRN-MOST OF THESE BOUNDARIES WILL BECOME STNRY OVER THE SRN HIGH PLNS/SW TX LATER TODAY/TNGT.

sections.title: NORTHEAST/MID ATLANTIC/CNTRL APPALACHIANS TODAY
sections.text: EXTENDED CORRIDOR OF NEARLY-CLEAR SKIES OVERLAPPED WITH HIGH PW /AROUND 1.75 IN/...MODERATELY STEEP LAPSE RATES...AND 30-40 KT 700-500 MB WSWLY FLOW SHOULD PROVE FAVORABLE FOR FAIRLY WIDESPREAD STRONG TO SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT WITH SFC HEATING TODAY FROM PA NNEWD INTO WRN/SRN NEW ENGLAND /REF MCD 1252 AND WW 384/. DEVELOPMENT WILL BE FURTHERED BY THE CONTINUED NE MOVEMENT OF UPR IMPULSE THAT CROSSED THE LWR OH VLY YESTERDAY AND IS NOW OVER WV/WRN PA. BANDS/SMALL CLUSTERS OF SUSTAINED STORMS...POSSIBLY INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS...WILL PRODUCE LOCALLY DMGG WIND...SVR HAIL...AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO AS THE ACTIVITY MOVES/DEVELOPS GENERALLY ENEWD THROUGH EARLY TNGT. ANY TORNADO THREAT SHOULD BE GREATEST IN PLACES SUCH AS THE HUDSON AND CT RVR VLYS...WHERE NEAR-SFC FLOW WILL REMAIN LOCALLY BACKED. SOMEWHAT WEAKER DEEP SHEAR AND ASCENT WILL EXIST FARTHER S INTO THE DELMARVA REGION AND CNTRL APPALACHIANS. NEVERTHELESS...AMPLE INSTABILITY WILL EXIST AMIDST MODEST SWLY MID-LVL FLOW TO SUPPORT SCTD TO NUMEROUS CLUSTERS/BANDS OF MULTICELLS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND/MARGINALLY SVR HAIL THROUGH EARLY TNGT.

sections.title: LWR MS VLY/SRN PLNS WWD INTO SRN RCKYS/AZ THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: UNINHIBITED SFC HEATING WILL LEAD TO VERY STRONG SFC INSTABILITY /SBCAPE AOA 4000 J PER KG/ OVER PARTS OF E TX...LA...AND SW MS TODAY...WHERE VERY MOIST AIR WILL PERSIST BENEATH MODERATELY STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATES. FORCING FOR ASCENT AND DEEP SHEAR WILL REMAIN WEAK...ALTHOUGH WV IMAGERY DOES SUGGEST PRESENCE OF A NRLY STNRY UPR-LVL FEATURE THAT COULD LOCALLY ENHANCE UPR DIVERGENCE AND POTENTIAL FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT FROM SW MS SSWWD INTO SW/S CNTRL LA. SETUP COULD YIELD OCCASIONAL STRONG DOWNDRAFTS/WET MICROBURSTS AND POSSIBLY SVR HAIL. SOMEWHAT DRIER CONDITIONS WILL PREVAIL FARTHER W INTO SW TX AND SE NM...ALONG AND S OF STALLING FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES. DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ALONG THE BOUNDARIES...AND POSSIBLY WEAK ASCENT PROVIDED BY RESIDUAL MCV CIRCULATIONS...SHOULD FOSTER STORM DEVELOPMENT WITH SFC HEATING. SIZABLE TEMPERATURE-DEW POINT SPREADS AND CLIMATOLOGICALLY RICH MOISTURE SUGGEST POTENTIAL FOR A FEW INSTANCE OF SVR WIND/HAIL. MORE ISOLD SVR WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR WITH DIURNAL STORMS FORMING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND MOGOLLON RIM WWD INTO AZ. ..CORFIDI/SMITH.. 07/02/2014

outlooks.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND OCCASIONAL HAIL WILL OCCUR FROM PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST SOUTHWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...AND OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. MORE ISOLATED STRONG TO MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM ARIZONA TO THE SOUTHERN PLAINS.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... THUNDERSTORMS WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND AND OCCASIONAL HAIL WILL OCCUR FROM PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST SOUTHWARD INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...AND OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. MORE ISOLATED STRONG TO MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM ARIZONA TO THE SOUTHERN PLAINS.

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND INTO THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC STATES
sections.text: PRIMARY CLUSTER OF SEVERE STORMS IS MOVING NEWD FROM ERN PA AND NWRN NJ/SERN NY/ AND WRN MA INTO SRN PARTS OF VT AND NH...ASSOCIATED WITH A PERTURBATION IN THE SWLY FLOW ALOFT MOVING ACROSS CENTRAL PA/NY ATTM. THE REGION IS ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF STRONGER WINDS ALOFT THAT ARE CONTRIBUTING TO SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR /30-35 KT IN THE LOWEST 6 KM/ TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORMS AND BRIEF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES...WITHIN A THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT THAT IS MOIST/UNSTABLE WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE 70S AND CAPE NEAR 2000 J/KG. THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND OCCASIONAL HAIL IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE INTO THE EVENING HOURS BEFORE STORM INTENSITY BEGINS TO DIMINISH. SEE FORTHCOMING MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1257 FOR MORE SHORT-TERM DETAILS. OTHER SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ACROSS NRN PARTS OF VA AND MD...WITH A CONTINUING THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT FARTHER SOUTH INTO SWRN/SOUTH CENTRAL VA.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A SLIGHT RISK/15% SEVERE WIND AREA HAS BEEN ADDED TO PARTS OF LA AND MS WHERE STRONG/SEVERE STORMS HAVE ORGANIZED ALONG A LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE BOUNDARY...ENHANCED BY A UPPER LEVEL IMPULSE MOVING SLOWLY EWD ACROSS THE REGION. STEEP LOW-MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE ENHANCING INSTABILITY WITHIN A VERY MOIST AIR MASS RESULTING IN CAPE OF 3500-4000 J/KG...PROMOTING FORMATION OF INTENSE UPDRAFTS. LARGE DCAPE OF 1000-1200 J/KG AND SUFFICIENTLY HIGH PW WILL SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF STRONG DOWNDRAFTS ENHANCED BY WATER LOADING PROCESSES...FAVORING OCCURRENCE OF WET MICROBURSTS WITH STRONGER CELLS. ..WEISS.. 07/02/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1125 AM CDT WED JUL 02 2014/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND STRENGTH FROM WEST-EAST ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE NORTHEAST STATES THROUGH THE MORNING INTO THE AFTERNOON. STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE LIKELY...PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. WW ISSUANCE IS LIKELY BY LATE MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MORNING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED A SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRACKING NEWD THROUGH THE LOWER GREAT LAKES REGION...AND A SECOND UPSTREAM WAVE MOVING EWD THROUGH LOWER MI/NRN IND. AN ATTENDANT BAND OF 50-60 KT SWLY 500 MB WINDS EXTENDS FROM THE UPPER OH VALLEY TO SRN QUEBEC PER 12Z SOUNDINGS...WITH THESE WINDS SPEEDS EXPECTED TO BE SUSTAINED THROUGH THE DAY AND SHIFT SOMEWHAT EWD ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...ENHANCING BULK SHEAR. MOSAIC RADAR/VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA SHOWED CU/TCU AND A FEW CB DEVELOPMENT ALREADY UNDERWAY FROM WRN/CENTRAL PA INTO CENTRAL NY AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZES...GIVEN ABUNDANT SURFACE HEATING PER MAINLY CLEAR SKIES IN THE PRE-CONVECTIVE ENVIRONMENT. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED MUCH OF THE DISCUSSION AREA IS ALREADY MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND UNCAPPED. THIS IS CONFIRMED PER MODIFICATION OF THE 12Z ALB SOUNDING FOR CURRENT SURFACE TEMP/ DEWPOINT SHOWING NO INHIBITION AND MLCAPE NEAR 2000 J/KG. DESPITE VERY WEAK HEIGHT FALLS...FURTHER DESTABILIZATION WITH THE AIR MASS BECOMING STRONGLY UNSTABLE AND STRENGTHENING BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS FAVORING LINE SEGMENTS/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. TRANSIENT ROTATING STRUCTURES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE AS EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR INCREASES TO 35-45 KT FROM NEAR THE PA/MD BORDER NWD THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED FOR MUCH OF MD AND VA...AND PORTIONS OF ERN WV AND PERHAPS NRN NC THIS AFTERNOON. TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE...ESPECIALLY ACROSS ERN WV INTO MD AND NRN/CENTRAL VA. MORE ISOLATED STORM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED FARTHER SWD INTO NRN NC. STRONG-SEVERE STORMS WILL BE LIKELY PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODIFIED 12Z IAD SOUNDING WITH CURRENT SURFACE TEMPERATURES ALREADY RISING TO AROUND 90 F WITHIN A MOISTURE RICH ENVIRONMENT RESULTS IN NO INHIBITION FOR SURFACE BASED STORMS...WITH SBCAPE EXCEEDING 3000 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY IS CURRENTLY BEING REALIZED WITH THE TSTMS THAT HAVE FORMED IN ERN WV /TUCKER COUNTY/ INTO THE WRN MD PANHANDLE /GARRETT AND ALLEGANY COUNTIES/. MEANWHILE...VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED CU FORMING ACROSS THE APPALACHIANS SWD FROM PA TO NERN TN/WRN NC...AND WITHIN A NNE-SSW CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE FROM NRN/WRN VA TO WRN NC. GIVEN THE UNCAPPED AND VERY STRONG INSTABILITY...TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE/STRENGTH. STRONGEST MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW ATTENDANT TO THE GREAT LAKES/OH VALLEY TROUGH IS EXPECTED ACROSS NRN PORTIONS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA WITH SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR STORM ORGANIZATION. MULTICELL STORM MODE CAN BE EXPECTED...THOUGH SOME TRANSIENT ROTATING STRUCTURES WILL BE POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY FROM ERN WV THROUGH NRN VA AND MD...WHERE DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL BE STRONGER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP AND/OR MOVE INTO THE MID-ATLANTIC TO THE NEW ENGLAND STATES THIS AFTERNOON...WITH STORMS BECOMING STRONG TO SEVERE PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. WW ISSUANCE IS LIKELY FROM PARTS OF NEW ENGLAND SWD TO NJ...SERN PA AND PERHAPS PORTIONS OF THE DELMARVA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SURFACE HEATING HAS RESULTED IN TEMPERATURES ALREADY AT ABOVE NORMAL READINGS AROUND NOON IN THE UPPER 80S TO LOWER 90S FROM SERN PA AND NJ NWD TO NH. THIS HEATING OCCURRING WITHIN THE PRESENCE OF A MOISTURE RICH ENVIRONMENT /PW VALUES OF 1.7 TO NEAR 2 INCHES/ HAS RESULTED IN MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY ACROSS MUCH OF THE MID-ATLANTIC REGION TO NEW ENGLAND. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN FROM WEST TO EAST AND BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR MULTICELLS AND PERHAPS A FEW SUPERCELLS. THESE FACTORS WILL SUPPORT DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL AS THE PRIMARY THREATS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON TO EARLY EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS ARE FORECAST TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON AND PERSIST INTO THE EARLY EVENING HOURS. WET MICROBURSTS CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER DOWNDRAFTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AT 1830Z SHOWS A CU FIELD FROM ERN TX NEWD INTO CNTRL MS AHEAD OF A SEWD-MOVING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY DRAPED FROM EXTREME SERN AR SWWD TO 25 MI SW SHV. THIS BOUNDARY BECOMES INCREASINGLY DIFFUSE WITH SWWD EXTENT OVER NWRN LA. 18Z SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW THAT TEMPS HAVE RISEN TO OR EXCEEDED 90 DEG F WITH LOWER 70S DEWPOINTS. MODIFYING THE 12Z RAOBS FROM SHV AND JAN FOR CURRENT SURFACE CONDITIONS RESULTS IN A VERY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER /2700-3800 J PER KG MLCAPE/ AND ESSENTIALLY THE REMOVAL OF ANY APPRECIABLE REMAINING CINH. ALTHOUGH TROPOSPHERIC WINDS ARE WEAK...HIGH PW AND 0-3 KM LAPSE RATES 8-9 DEG C PER WILL SUPPORT WET MICROBURST POTENTIAL. LOCALIZED POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE ARE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER DOWNDRAFTS AS STORMS MATURE. RELATIVELY COOL H5 TEMPS /-9 TO -10 DEG C/ OBSERVED ON THE MORNING RAOBS MAY FOSTER A FEW INSTANCES OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WITH THE STRONGER UPDRAFT PULSES. IF A SEMI-CONGEALED CLUSTER OF STORMS CAN EVOLVE OVER THE NEXT HR OR SO...THE POSSIBILITY FOR A SMALL SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH AHEAD AND DOWNSTREAM OF THE STORMS MAY BE CONSIDERED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS PRODUCING SEVERE WEATHER /PRIMARILY DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL/ ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP AND/OR SPREAD FROM WRN MAINE INTO THE REST OF THIS STATE DURING THE MID-LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING. WW ISSUANCE IS LIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AIR MASS ACROSS MUCH OF MAINE HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE PRESENCE OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT...GIVEN THE CLOSER PROXIMITY TO 50+ KT SWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW ATTENDANT TO THE GREAT LAKES TROUGH. STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ACROSS NH AND WRN MAINE. GIVEN THE FAVORABLE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT INTO CENTRAL...ERN AND NRN MAINE...ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ALONG WITH ACTIVITY MOVING E/NEWD FROM WRN MAINE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER CONTINUES ACROSS MAINLY THE ERN PORTIONS OF WW 384 INTO WW 386 THIS AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...A ZONE OF DEEP LAYER CONVERGENCE ALSO EXISTS FROM CENTRAL NY SSWWD THROUGH CENTRAL PARTS OF PA WHERE RECENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED...AND THE AIR MASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE. A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE YET THIS AFTERNOON FROM LYCOMING COUNTY PA TO THE SOUTHEAST OF UCA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED STORMS ACROSS THE NORTHEAST U.S. HAVE CONGEALED INTO A BAND EXTENDING FROM SRN NH THROUGH WRN MA...NWRN CT...SERN NY TO NERN PA. THE AIR MASS WITHIN AND EAST OF THIS ONGOING BAND OF STORMS REMAINS STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT SUPPORTING A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND SOME HAIL. THE ENVIRONMENT TO THE WEST OF THIS MAIN BAND OF STORMS INTO EAST CENTRAL NY HAS BEEN CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED AND SHOULD LIMIT THE DEVELOPMENT OF ADDITIONAL SEVERE STORMS IN THIS PORTION OF WW 384. HOWEVER...PARTS OF NRN AND ERN VT REMAIN MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND STRONGLY SHEARED SUGGESTING THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CANNOT BE RULED OUT. THE PRESENCE OF ONGOING STORMS AND OVERSHOOTING TOPS IN THESE PARTS OF VT PER RADAR AND SATELLITE IMAGERY CONFIRM THIS POTENTIAL AS WELL. MEANWHILE...A CORRIDOR OF DEEP LAYER MOISTURE FLUX CONVERGENCE EXTENDED FROM THE ERN WV PANHANDLE THROUGH CENTRAL PA. A FEW STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED WITHIN THIS CORRIDOR AS THE AIR MASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND STRONGLY SHEARED TO SUPPORT AT LEAST AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS...GENERALLY EAST OF A LINE FROM AOO TO UNV TO INVOF BGM TO EAST OF UCA. ..PETERS.. 07/02/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND MARGINAL HAIL REMAIN POSSIBLE MAINLY ACROSS WRN AND NRN SECTIONS OF WW 385.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG INSTABILITY REMAINS ACROSS THE REGION WITH LITTLE CIN. AS SUCH...NEW DEVELOPMENT WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE ALONG ANY OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES FROM NRN VA INTO MD...AS WELL AS ALONG SLOWLY PROPAGATING STORMS ACROSS WRN VA. ISOLATED WET MICROBURSTS WILL REMAIN THE MAIN THREAT ALONG WITH MAINLY SMALL HAIL. ..JEWELL.. 07/02/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS AND OCCASIONAL HAIL SHOULD PERSIST FOR THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...AND IS LIKELY TO EXTEND E OF WW 387. THE MARGINAL AND SHORT-LIVED NATURE OF THE THREAT WILL PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A NEW WW INTO PARTS OF FAR ERN MS AND WRN AL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SATELLITE/RADAR TRENDS SHOW OUTFLOW SURGING S/EWD FROM EARLIER TSTM COMPLEX...REINFORCING A WEAK EFFECTIVE COLD FRONT POSITIONED GENERALLY FROM W-E ACROSS THE REGION. A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /2000-3000 J/KG PER RAP OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS/ PERSISTS...SUPPORTING GENERATION OF NEW AND RELATIVELY ISOLATED UPDRAFT PULSES. HOWEVER...VERY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR IS LARGELY RESULTING IN UNORGANIZED CONVECTION...WITH EXCEPTION OF A COUPLE MULTICELL CLUSTERS PROPAGATING EWD ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS NERN MS...WHERE MIDLEVEL FLOW IS ALSO SLIGHTLY STRONGER. PRIMARY HAZARD WILL CONTINUE TO BE INSTANCES OF STRONG TO MARGINALLY SVR WIND GUSTS...AND PERHAPS HAIL OCCASIONALLY APPROACHING SVR LIMITS WITHIN THE STRONGER CORES. HOWEVER...INSTABILITY SHOULD SLOWLY WANE THROUGH THE EVENING WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING...WITH A SUBSEQUENT DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE TRENDS ANTICIPATED. ..ROGERS.. 07/02/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...
